21201.meaning1: physical calmness; bodily tranquillity; (comm) tranquillity of feeling, perception and mental activities

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, kāyappassaddhi cittappassaddhi. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā nisīdanaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ vā kāyabandhanaṃ vā apanidheyya vā apanidhāpeyya vā antamaso has'āpekkho'pi, pācittiyaṃ.

21203.meaning1: bodily strength; physical force; physical effort
21203.commentary: (MNa) kāyabalenā'ti bāhā khipanto sarīrato sedehi muccantehi na kāyabalena gacchati.

examples.text: so gacchanto na satthiṃ unnāmeti, na satthiṃ onāmeti, na satthiṃ sannāmeti, na satthiṃ vināmeti. gacchato kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa adharakāyo'va iñjati, na ca kāyabalena gacchati.

21204.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of kāyabala
21204.commentary: (MNa) kāyabalenā'ti bāhā khipanto sarīrato sedehi muccantehi na kāyabalena gacchati.

examples.text: so gacchanto na satthiṃ unnāmeti, na satthiṃ onāmeti, na satthiṃ sannāmeti, na satthiṃ vināmeti. gacchato kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa adharakāyo'va iñjati, na ca kāyabalena gacchati.

21205.meaning1: self-mortification; physical torture; painful ascetic practices
21205.commentary: (MNa) no kāyabhāvanan'ti pañc'ātapatappan'ādiṃ attakilamath'ānuyogaṃ sandhāy'āha. ayañ'hi tesaṃ kāyabhāvanā nāma.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bho gotama, evaṃ hoti, addhā bhoto gotamassa sāvakā cittabhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti, no kāyabhāvanan'ti.

21206.meaning1: development of the body; physical cultivation; (comm) insight
21206.commentary: (MNa) kāyabhāvanā'ti pana vipassanā vuccati, tāya cittavikkhepaṃ pāpuṇanto nāma n'atthi, iti nigaṇṭho asantaṃ abhūtaṃ yaṃ n'atthi, tadev'āha.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ etadavoca, yā'pi kho te esā, aggivessana, purimā kāyabhāvanā bhāsitā sā'pi ariyassa vinaye no dhammikā kāyabhāvanā.

21207.meaning1: devoted to the practice of physical torture
21207.meaningLit: devoted to the practice of developing the body
21207.commentary: (MNa) no kāyabhāvanan'ti pañc'ātapatappan'ādiṃ attakilamath'ānuyogaṃ sandhāy'āha. ayañ'hi tesaṃ kāyabhāvanā nāma. kiṃ pana so disvā evam'āha? so kira div'ādivassa vihāraṃ āgacchati, tasmiṃ kho pana samaye bhikkhū pattacīvaraṃ paṭisāmetvā attano attano rattiṭṭhānadivāṭṭhānesu paṭisallānaṃ upagacchanti. so te paṭisallīne disvā cittabhāvanāmattaṃ ete anuyuñjanti, kāyabhāvanā pan'etesaṃ n'atthī'ti maññamāno evam'āha.

examples.text: santi, bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāyabhāvan'ānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti, no cittabhāvanaṃ.

21208.meaning2: connected with the body and mind

21210.meaning1: physical sagacity; being a sage in body
21210.commentary: (ANa) kāyamunin'ti kāyadvāre muniṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhaṃ, kāyena vā muniṃ. sesadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: kāyamuniṃ vacīmuniṃ, cetomuniṃ anāsavaṃ, muniṃ moneyyasampannaṃ, āhu sabbappahāyinan'ti.

21211.commentary: (DNa) tesaṃ vitthāro tattha katamaṃ kāyamoneyyaṃ? tividhakāyaduccaritassa pahānaṃ kāyamoneyyaṃ, tividhaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ kāyamoneyyaṃ, kāy'ārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ kāyamoneyyaṃ, kāyapariññā kāyamoneyyaṃ, kāyapariññāsahagato maggo kāyamoneyyaṃ, kāyasmiṃ chandarāgappahānaṃ kāyamoneyyaṃ, kāyasaṅkhāranirodhā catutthajjhānasamāpatti kāyamoneyyaṃ. (ANa) kāyamoneyyan'ti kāyadvāre munibhāvo sādhubhāvo paṇḍitabhāvo. sesadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tīṇi moneyyāni, kāyamoneyyaṃ, vacīmoneyyaṃ, manomoneyyaṃ.

iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkhurogo sotarogo ghānarogo jivhārogo kāyarogo sīsarogo kaṇṇarogo mukharogo dantarogo oṭṭharogo kāso sāso pināso ḍāho jaro kucchirogo mucchā

21213.meaning1: (abhi) lightness of the body; physical buoyancy

examples.text: katamā tasmiṃ samaye kāyalahutā hoti? yā tasmiṃ samaye vedanākkhandhassa saññākkhandhassa saṅkhārakkhandhassa lahutā lahupariṇāmatā adandhanatā avitthanatā, ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye kāyalahutā hoti.

21214.meaning1: liberated through the experience of jhāna and the formless attainments; epithet of a stream-enterer or higher
21214.commentary: (MNa) phuṭṭh'antaṃ sacchikarotī'ti kāyasakkhī. yo jhānaphassaṃ paṭhamaṃ phusati, pacchā nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti, so sot'āpattiphalaṭṭhaṃ ādiṃ katvā yāva arahattamaggaṭṭhā chabbidho hontī'ti veditabbo. ten'ev'āha, idh'ekacco puggalo aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti. ayaṃ vuccati puggalo kāyasakkhī'ti.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, api nu tvaṃ, bhaddāli, tasmiṃ samaye ubhatobhāgavimutto vā hosi paññāvimutto vā kāyasakkhi vā diṭṭhippatto vā saddhāvimutto vā dhamm'ānusārī vā saddh'ānusārī vā'ti?
katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo kāyasakkhi? idha ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.

21215.meaning1: liberated through the experience of jhāna and the formless attainments; epithet of a stream-enterer or higher
21215.meaning2: he who has realized the final truth (through the body), body-witness (who has attained all 8 samāpatti and any of the 4 paths or first 3 fruitions)
21215.commentary: (ANa) kāyasakkhī'ti kāyena jhānaphassaṃ phusitvā pacchā nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ sacchikatvā ṭhito.

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phusitvā viharati. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, kāyasakkhī vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena.

21217.commentary: (MNa) kāyasaṅkhārā'ti assāsapassāsā. (SNa) tattha kāyappaṭibaddhattā kāyena saṅkharīyati nibbattīyatī'ti kāyasaṅkhāro.

examples.text: yv'āyaṃ, āvuso, mato kālaṅ'kato tassa kāyasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, vacīsaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, cittasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, āyu parikkhīṇo, usmā vūpasantā, indriyāni paribhinnāni.
passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

21218.meaning1: intention which results in bodily action
21218.commentary: (MNa) kāyadvāre gahaṇādi-vasena copanappattā dvādasa akusalacetanā sabyābajjhakāyasaṅkhāro nāma.

examples.text: katamañ'ca, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ? idha, puṇṇa, ekacco sabyābajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
tattha katame avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā? puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro, apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāro, āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāro, kāyasaṅkhāro, vacīsaṅkhāro, cittasaṅkhāro.

21219.commentary: (ADha) kāyasañcetanā'ti kāyaviññattiṃ samuṭṭhāpetvā kāyadvārato pavattā aṭṭha kām'āvacarakusalacetanā dvādasa akusalacetanā'ti samavīsati cetanā, kāyadvāre ādānaggahaṇacopanaṃ pāpayamānā uppannā vīsati kusal'ākusalacetanā'ti'pi vattuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: tattha katamo kāyasaṅkhāro? kāyasañcetanā kāyasaṅkhāro, vacīsañcetanā vacīsaṅkhāro, manosañcetanā cittasaṅkhāro.

21220.meaning1: due to intention regarding the body; caused by physical volition

examples.text: kāyasañcetanāhetū'ti kāyasañcetanāpaccayā. uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhan'ti aṭṭhakusalakammapaccayā niyak'ajjhatte sukhaṃ uppajjati, dvādasaakusalakammapaccayā dukkhaṃ.

21221.meaning1: due to intention regarding the body; caused by physical volition

examples.text: kāye vā h'ānanda, sati kāyasañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. vācāya vā h'ānanda, sati vacīsañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.

21223.meaning1: physical corruption; defilement of the body

21224.commentary: (DNa) kāyasamācāram'pī'ti-ādi sevitabba-kāyasamācār'ādi-vasena pātimokkhasaṃvara-dassan'atthaṃ vuttaṃ. sīlakathā ca nām'esā kammapathavasena vā paṇṇattivasena vā kathetabbā hoti.

examples.text: pañc'ime, āvuso, āghātapaṭivinayā yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo. katame pañca? idh'āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro.
codakena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā paraṃ codetu'kāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, parisuddhakāyasamācāro nu kho'mhi, parisuddhen'amhi kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vappa, ye kāyasamārambhapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, kāyasamārambhā paṭiviratassa evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.

21227.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of kāyasamārambhapaccaya
21227.meaning1: due to physical exertion; due to initiating bodily action
21227.construction:
kāya + samārambha + paccaya + ā
kāyasamārambhapaccaya + ā

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vappa, ye kāyasamārambhapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, kāyasamārambhā paṭiviratassa evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.

21228.meaning1: physical contact; somatic impression; bodily experience

examples.text: yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo kāyasamphassassa uppādāya, so'pi hetu so'pi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī. aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppanno kāyasamphasso kuto nicco bhavissati!
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ

21229.meaning1: caused by physical contact; produced by somatic impression; born from bodily experience

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, vedanā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā, cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, jivhāsamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ

21230.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of kāyasamphassapaccaya
21230.meaning1: dependent on physical contact; due to somatic impression
21230.construction:
kāya + samphassa + paccaya + ā
kāyasamphassapaccaya + ā

examples.text: kāyasmiṃ sati kāyasamphassapaccayā uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ. manasmiṃ sati manosamphassapaccayā
kāyaṃ aññato passati, phoṭṭhabbe aññato passati, kāyaviññāṇaṃ aññato passati, kāyasamphassaṃ aññato passati, yam'p'idaṃ kāyasamphassapaccayā

21231.meaning1: bodily experience and the corresponding field of consciousness; somatic impression and the associated dimension of knowing
21231.commentary: (SNa) cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanan'ti cakkhuviññāṇena sampayutto cakkhusamphasso'pi viññāṇ'āyatanam'pi mam'evā'ti. ettha ca cakkhusamphassena viññāṇasampayuttakā dhammā gahitā, viññāṇ'āyatanena sabbāni'pi cakkhudvāre uppannāni āvajjan'ādiviññāṇāni. sotadvār'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tav'eva, pāpima, jivhā, tava rasā, tava jivhāsamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ … tav'eva, pāpima, kāyo, tava phoṭṭhabbā, tava kāyasamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ … tav'eva, pāpima, mano, tava dhammā, tava manosamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ.

cakkhusamphass'āyatanaṃ, sotasamphass'āyatanaṃ, ghānasamphass'āyatanaṃ, jivhāsamphass'āyatanaṃ, kāyasamphass'āyatanaṃ, manosamphass'āyatanaṃ. chaphass'āyatano ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

21233.meaning1: physical contact; physical intimacy; touching the body

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthaggāhaṃ vā veṇiggāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅgh'ādiseso.

tassa kāyikā'pi darathā pahīyanti, cetasikā'pi darathā pahīyanti, kāyikā'pi santāpā pahīyanti, cetasikā'pi santāpā pahīyanti, kāyikā'pi pariḷāhā pahīyanti, cetasikā'pi pariḷāhā pahīyanti. so kāyasukham'pi cetosukham'pi paṭisaṃvedeti.

21236.meaning1: good physical conduct; virtuous bodily behaviour

examples.text: aho vata ayam'āyasmā kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveyya, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveyya, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveyya!
ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā

21237.meaning1: who has the quality of ethical physical conduct; who has virtuous bodily behaviour

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ kāyasucaritasamaṅgī taṃnidānā tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyya, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī'ti pajānāti
kāyasuciṃ vacīsuciṃ, cetosuciṃ anāsavaṃ, suciṃ soceyyasampannaṃ, āhu ninhātapāpakan'ti.

21241.commentary: (DNa) soceyyānī'ti sucibhāvakarā soceyyappaṭipadā dhammā. vitthāro pan'ettha tattha katamaṃ kāyasoceyyaṃ? pāṇ'ātipātā veramaṇī'ti-ādinā nayena vuttānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ sucaritānaṃ vasena veditabbo.

examples.text: tīṇi soceyyāni, kāyasoceyyaṃ, vacīsoceyyaṃ, manosoceyyaṃ.

21242.meaning1: affection for the body; love for the physical body
21242.commentary: (MNa) yo kāyasmiṃ kāyachando'ti yā kāyasmiṃ taṇhā. sneho'ti taṇhāsneho'va. kāy'anvayatā'ti kāy'ānugamanabhāvo, kāyaṃ anugacchanakakileso'ti attho.

examples.text: tass'imaṃ kāyaṃ aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassato yo kāyasmiṃ kāyachando kāyasneho kāy'anvayatā sā pahīyati.

21243.meaning1: after the breakup of the body; after the end of one's lifespan

examples.text: yāv'assa kāyo ṭhassati tāva naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā na naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā'ti
kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh'eva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītī bhavissantī'ti pajānāti.

21244.meaning1: after the breakup of the body, after death

examples.text: m'āyaṃ āyasmā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjī'ti! evaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo.
pasaṃsā me āgacchatū'ti sīlaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito, bhogā me uppajjantū'ti sīlaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmī'ti sīlaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito.

21245.meaning1: awareness of the body; mindfulness of the body

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, saṃvaro hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe n'ādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso

21246.meaning1: crookedness of action; devious activity; physical misconduct

examples.text: eta'r'ahi kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kusalo kāyavaṅkānaṃ kāyadosānaṃ kāyakasāvānaṃ, kusalo vacīvaṅkānaṃ vacīdosānaṃ vacīkasāvānaṃ, kusalo manovaṅkānaṃ manodosānaṃ manokasāvānaṃ.

ten'ev'āha ujugatāssa diṭṭhi dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato āgato imaṃ saddhamman'ti, lok'uttara-kusala-sammādiṭṭhi'y'eva hi antadvayam'anupagamma ujubhāvena gatattā, kāyavaṅk'ādīni ca sabbavaṅkāni samucchinditvā gatattā ujugatā hoti

21248.commentary: (ADha) kāyaviññattī'ti ettha tāva kāyena attano bhāvaṃ viññāpentānaṃ tiracchānehi'pi purisānaṃ, purisehi vā tiracchānānam'pi kāyagahaṇ'ānusārena gahitāya etāya bhāvo viññāyatī'ti viññatti'.
21248.notes: (CMA) a type of mind-produced material phenomenon by which a person expresses, through the medium of the body, a volition arisen in the mind

examples.text: dve'mā, mahārāja, viññattiyo kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti cā'ti. tattha atthi kāyaviññatti sāvajjā, atthi anavajjā. atthi vacīviññatti sāvajjā, atthi anavajjā.

21249.commentary: (MNa) viññāṇavāre cakkhuviññāṇan'ti cakkhumhi viññāṇaṃ, cakkhuto vā jātaṃ viññāṇan'ti cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. evaṃ sotaghānajivhākāyaviññāṇāni.

examples.text: kāyañ'c'āvuso paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ.

aṭṭhārasa kho imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu, saddadhātu, sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.

21251.meaningLit: to be known by body knowing

examples.text: kāyaṃ, āvuso channa, kāyaviññāṇaṃ kāyaviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti samanupassasi?

21252.meaning1: touchable; tangible; known by the body
21252.meaning2: to be perceived by the sense of touch
21252.meaningLit: to be known by the body

examples.text: bhusā ce'pi kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā kāyassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, n'ev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti. amissīkatam'ev'assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañ'c'ass'ānupassati.
ye te kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā asamphuṭṭhā asamphuṭṭhapubbā, na ca phusasi, na ca te hoti phuseyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

21254.commentary: (DNa) kāyaviveko nāma gaṇasaṅgaṇikaṃ vinodetvā aṭṭha-ārambhavatthu-vasena ekībhāvo. (DHPa) kāyaviveko'ti kāyassa ekībhāvo. (UDa) tesu eko gacchati, eko tiṭṭhati, eko nisīdati, eko seyyaṃ kappeti, eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati, eko paṭikkamati, eko abhikkamati, eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, eko carati, eko viharatī'ti evaṃ sabb'iriyāpathesu sabbakiccesu gaṇasaṅgaṇikaṃ pahāya vivittavāso kāyaviveko nāma.

examples.text: so eko gacchati, eko tiṭṭhati, eko nisīdati, eko seyyaṃ kappeti, eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati, eko paṭikkamati, eko raho nisīdati, eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, eko carati viharati iriyati vattati pāleti yapeti yāpeti. ayaṃ kāyaviveko.
tathārūpānaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena vūpakaṭṭho viharati, kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca.
so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena sampādeti, kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca.
suṇantu me bhonto, mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, samaṇo me gotamo nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena. yena me kāyaveyāvaṭṭikaṃ kareyyāthā'ti.
suṇantu me bhonto, mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, samaṇo me gotamo nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena. yena me kāyaveyyāvaṭikaṃ kareyyāthā'ti.
suṇantu me bhonto, mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, samaṇo me gotamo nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena. yena me kāyaveyyāvatikaṃ kareyyāthā'ti.
itaro taṃ āharitvā paccekabuddhassa hatthe ṭhapetvā ahaṃ bhante tumhākaṃ katena iminā kāyaveyyāvatikena yattha yattha nibbatto'pi vāhanasampanno homī'ti patthanaṃ akāsi.

21260.meaning1: in-between the bodies; in-between the masses
21260.commentary: (MNa) sattannaṃtv'eva kāyānan'ti yathā muggar'āsi'ādīsu pahaṭaṃ satthaṃ muggar'āsiādīnaṃ antarena pavisati, evaṃ sattannaṃ kāyānaṃ antarena chiddena vivarena satthaṃ pavisati. tattha ahaṃ imaṃ jīvitā voropemī'ti kevalaṃ saññāmattam'eva hotī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: tattha n'atthi hantā vā ghātetā vā sotā vā sāvetā vā viññātā vā viññāpetā vā. yo'pi tiṇhena satthena sīsaṃ chindati, na koci kañci jīvitā voropeti. sattannaṃtv'eva kāyānam'antarena satthaṃ vivaram'anupatati.

21261.meaning1: following the body; body contemplation; observing the body
21261.commentary: (NIDD1a) kāy'ānupassanā'ti kāyassa anupassanā, kāyaṃ vā anupassanā, kāye'ti ca vatvā'pi puna kāy'ānupassanā'ti dutiyaṃ kāyaggahaṇaṃ asammissato vavatthāna-ghanavinibbhog'ādi-dassan'atthaṃ katan'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: kāy'ānupassanā ān'āpānapabbaṃ

21262.meaning1: preceded by contemplation of the body, etc.

21263.meaning1: observing the body; who watches the body

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassī viharati
yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dīghaṃ vā assasanto dīghaṃ assasāmī'ti pajānāti… kāye kāy'ānupassī, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.

21265.meaning1: field of the body organ; tactile sphere

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ, sot'āyatanaṃ, ghān'āyatanaṃ, jivh'āyatanaṃ, kāy'āyatanaṃ, man'āyatanaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ.
cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ sot'āyatanaṃ ghān'āyatanaṃ jivh'āyatanaṃ kāy'āyatanaṃ man'āyatanaṃ

21266.meaning1: based in the body; related to the body
21266.commentary: (SNa) kāy'ārammaṇo'ti yaṃ kāyaṃ anupassati, tam'eva ārammaṇaṃ katvā uppajjati kilesapariḷāho.

examples.text: tassa kāye kāy'ānupassino viharato kāy'ārammaṇo vā uppajjati kāyasmiṃ pariḷāho cetaso vā līnattaṃ bahiddhā vā cittaṃ vikkhipati

21267.commentary: (NIDD1a) kāy'ārammaṇe ñāṇan'ti kāyaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā anicc'ādi-vasena pavattaṃ kāy'ārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ.

21269.meaning1: fact of bodily laziness; fact of physical inertia

examples.text: arati-ādīsu ayonisomanasikārena thinamiddhassa uppādo hoti. tandī nāma kāy'ālasiyatā. vijambhitā nāma kāyavinamanā.

21270.meaning1: bodily; physical; related to the body
21270.meaning2: relating to the resulting from the body

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kumāra, api nu tassa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā uppajjeyyuṃ rāgajā pariḷāhā kāyikā vā cetasikā vā yehi so rāgajehi pariḷāhehi pariḍayhamāno dukkhaṃ sayeyyā'ti?

no ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhena kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, tassa bhavanti vattāro, iṅgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassū'ti, iti'ssa bhavanti vattāro

21271.meaning1: belonging to a body; part of a group; one of the host (of)

examples.text: paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā brahmakāyikā devā saddam'anussāvesuṃ, lābhā vata bho vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā vajjipajāya, yattha tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatā nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivutā dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāriyamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

tassa kāyikā'pi darathā pavaḍḍhanti, cetasikā'pi darathā pavaḍḍhanti, kāyikā'pi santāpā pavaḍḍhanti, cetasikā'pi santāpā pavaḍḍhanti, kāyikā'pi pariḷāhā pavaḍḍhanti, cetasikā'pi pariḷāhā pavaḍḍhanti. so kāyikadukkham'pi cetodukkham'pi paṭisaṃvedeti.

21276.meaning1: bodily and verbal; physical and vocal

examples.text: yatv'ādhikaraṇam'enaṃ kāy'indriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ
pañc'imāni, bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti. katamāni pañca? cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, sot'indriyaṃ, ghān'indriyaṃ, jivh'indriyaṃ, kāy'indriyaṃ.

21279.meaning1: restraint of the sense of touch

21280.meaning1: with the sense of touch restrained

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… sot'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… ghān'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… jivh'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… kāy'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… man'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati.

21282.meaning1: massive; with an imposing body; physically enormous

examples.text: apissu taṃ jano disvā evam'āha, abhirūpo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, dassanīyo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, pāsādiko vata, bho, rañño nāgo, kāy'upapanno vata, bho, rañño nāgo'ti!
evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, hatthim'eva nu kho, bhante, mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāy'upapannaṃ jano disvā evam'āha, nāgo vata, bho, nāgo'ti

21283.meaning2: bracelet (worn on the upper arm); arm-guard; (according to commentaries) a neck-ornament, necklace

21284.meaning1: being reborn; going to a new body
21284.meaning2: attached to the body, going to a new birth

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, bālo acari brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhakkhayāya. tasmā bālo kāyassa bhedā kāy'ūpago hoti, so kāy'ūpago samāno na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. na parimuccati dukkhasmā'ti vadāmi.

21285.meaning2: bracelet worn on the upper arm

21286.meaning1: one remains in the body, closely observing the body
21286.commentary: (PM) kathaṃ kāye kāy'ānupassī viharati? idh'ekacco pathavīkāyaṃ aniccato anupassati, no niccato, dukkhato anupassati, no sukhato, anattato anupassati, no attato, nibbindati, no nandati, virajjati, no rajjati, nirodheti, no samudeti, paṭinissajjati, no ādiyati. aniccato anupassanto niccasaññaṃ pajahati, dukkhato anupassanto sukhasaññaṃ pajahati, anattato anupassanto attasaññaṃ pajahati, nibbindanto nandiṃ pajahati, virajjanto rāgaṃ pajahati, nirodhento samudayaṃ pajahati, paṭinissajjanto ādānaṃ pajahati. imehi sattahi ākārehi kāyaṃ anupassati. kāyo upaṭṭhānaṃ, no sati.

21287.meaning1: having personally experienced; (comm) having touched with the mental body
21287.commentary: (SNa) kāyena ca phusitvā'ti nāmakāyena ca phusitvā paṭilabhitvā.

examples.text: acchariyā h'ete, āvuso, puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, ye amataṃ dhātuṃ kāyena phusitvā viharanti
evaṃ abhisaddahati, ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ, ten'āhaṃ eta'r'ahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi, paññāya ca ativijjha passāmī'ti.
yesañ'ca mayaṃ cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjāma, tesaṃ te kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mah'ānisaṃsā
dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi

21289.grammar: masc, agent, in comps, from karoti
21289.commentary: (THa) gahakāraṃ gavesanto'ti imassa attabhāvagehassa kārakaṃ taṇhāvaḍḍhakiṃ pariyesanto ettakaṃ kālaṃ anuvicarin'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: anekajātisaṃsāraṃ, sandhāvissaṃ anibbisaṃ, gahakāraṃ gavesanto, dukkhā jāti punappunaṃ.
tam'enaṃ suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakār'antevāsī vā jātarūpaṃ mūsāyaṃ pakkhipitvā dhamati sandhamati niddhamati.
akkharā'pi akāra-ādayo ekacattālīsaṃ sutt'ant'opakārā.
cakārena byañjane'pi
ken'āyaṃ pakato satto, kuvaṃ sattassa kārako, kuvaṃ satto samuppanno, kuvaṃ satto nirujjhatī'ti.
kammakāmā analasā, kammaseṭṭhassa kārakā, rāgaṃ dosaṃ pajahanti, tena me samaṇā piyā.
ārāmaropā vanaropā, ye janā setukārakā, papañ'ca udapānañ'ca, ye dadanti upassayaṃ.
gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayam'ajjhagā.

21295.meaning1: doing; making; performing; following; causing; creating
21295.synonym: kara, karaṇa, karaṇī, karī, kāra, kārī, janaka, janana, janika, janiya

examples.text: so na khulukhulukārakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na samparivattakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā hatthe dhovati, hatthesu dhotesu patto dhoto hoti, patte dhote hatthā dhotā honti.
kim'ahaṃ sīlasampannā, satthusāsanakārikā, nibbānaṃ n'ādhigacchāmi, akusītā anuddhatā.
kārako kārakatāya vādaṃ upeti, atha vā vuccamāno upavadiyamāno kuppati byāpajjati patiṭṭhiyati kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.

21299.meaning2: Saṅgha which performs a legal act; enacting Saṅgha
